items.title: The Brauer group of an algebraically closed field is trivial
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file brauer.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the Brauer group of an algebraically closed field is zero (statement lines 666-669). The proof is a complete argument: for a finite central skew field extension and an arbitrary element, the subalgebra generated by the element is a commutative finite integral algebra over the ground field and hence a field by a named result of the Algebra chapter; algebraic closedness forces that field to be the ground field, and since the element was arbitrary the extension is trivial (proof lines 671-677). The non-formal content is the elementwise reduction. The claim is H2.
